LESSON: DESCANT RECORDER

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.6: Descant Recorder

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Descant Recorder
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is the value of sight reading music?

1. perform simple melodies on a descant recorder observing performance directions
2. appreciate playing music in C major on the descant recorder

• Model 2: appreciate playing music in C major on the descant recorder

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Descant Recorder.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the value of sight reading music?
2. Why are performance directions important in music?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• perform simple melodies on a descant recorder observing performance directions
• appreciate playing music in C major on the descant recorder
